messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high 5xx error rate observed for ArgosCorp private ALB in VPC rp-42 (dedicated pool). 10%+ 502s since 09:14:32 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.
aj_oncall: Ack — taking ownership. Paging network and solutions-eng. @raj_net @jess_se :eyes:
raj_net: Looking now. Target group health checks showing failures; targets returning 503 for health checks, not app traffic. I see a security-group rule delta around 09:13 UTC (sg-08ac) that blocked our healthcheck CIDR. Pulling rule diff.
raj_net: `aws ec2 describe-security-group-rules --group-id sg-08ac --query 'SecurityGroupRules[*].[IpProtocol,IpRanges,Description]'` -> shows new ingress restricting 10.0.0.0/16 -> blocked ALB health source.
jess_se: I pinged Argos POC and asked if they pushed infra changes. They confirm a Terraform plan merged ~09:12 but claim it was for a separate subnet. Holding customer-facing comms until we know rollback effect.
sam_sre: Quick metrics: app RPS steady, error spike matches healthcheck fail timestamps. Likely healthcheck->502 cascade. No recent deploys from our side.
raj_net: Rolling back SG delta now (revoke then re-add previous). Running: `aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-08ac --ip-permissions ...` -> done. Applying previous rule set.
raj_net: Targets reporting healthy again at 09:16:10 UTC. ALB 502s dropping.
incident-bot: ALB target health stabilized. 502 rate reduced to baseline ~0.5%. Monitoring window 10m before auto-close.
olivia_support: Notified Argos. They saw intermittent 502s on client side; they confirm no application deploy on their end. They asked for timeline and remediation notes.
jess_se: Adding action items: keep rollback record, request Argos to revert Terraform drift, and add guardrail alert if SG changes block ALB healthcheck IPs. Linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/network/sg-drift-detection
aj_oncall: Initial summary for postmortem: root cause = customer-managed IaC change that inadvertently restricted ALB healthcheck sources. Mitigation = manual rollback of SG rules; effect restored in ~3m. Action items (brief): 1) coordinate RFC with Argos security for IaC guardrail (owner: jess_se). 2) add automated healthcheck-blocking guardrail alert to infra (owner: raj_net). 3) update onboarding docs for private VPC ALB healthcheck ranges (owner: olivia_support). I'll open INCIDENT-4321 with timeline.
customer_ops: Argos POC: thanks. They requested a short blameless postmortem and an RFC for guardrail within 24h.
sam_sre: Marking incident as resolved if metrics remain stable for 30m. Reopen if any regression. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Resolved: incident cleared at 09:22:48 UTC. Total duration ~8m16s.
